operations.details_summary: INSPIRE July 2026 download publication — Dataset published 5 July 2026 and available until the next monthly refresh. Limit: Publication date and availability window only; no parcel geometry bytes downloaded in this increment.
INSPIRE monthly cadence — New files are published on the first Sunday of each month. Limit: Cadence does not prove a specific local file was downloaded or hashed.
INSPIRE local-authority split — Files are divided by local authority area; boundary polygons may appear in both authority files. Limit: Authority partition is not a legal boundary determination.
INSPIRE GML and GIS requirement — Files are published as GML and require GIS software for viewing and processing. Limit: Format documentation does not validate any current local GML payload.
INSPIRE freehold scope — Dataset contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales. Limit: Leasehold and other omitted tenures cannot be inferred from absence.
Unique Land Registry INSPIRE ID — Each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relating to a registered title. Limit: The ID is not the title number and one title may contain multiple polygons.

Indicative extent limitation — The legal extent of a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE polygons; the title plan is required. Limit: Preserved candidate bindings remain non-legal spatial evidence.

British National Grid capture and reprojection warning — HMLR polygon coordinates are captured in British National Grid; reprojection can introduce positional error, potentially up to 15 metres. Limit: No reprojection error is treated as an exact parcel-boundary tolerance.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m dataset identity — Metadata identifier is 13787b9a-26a4-4775-8523-806d13af58fc for the 1m composite DTM. Limit: Metadata identity does not prove current response bytes.
LIDAR vertical accuracy — Vertical accuracy is stated as ±15 cm RMSE. Limit: RMSE is not a parcel-specific confidence interval.
LIDAR CRS — Coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700. Limit: CRS metadata does not verify exact polygon alignment.
LIDAR service interfaces — Dataset metadata lists WMS, WCS and WMTS access routes plus survey catalogue services. Limit: No live WCS GetCoverage response was obtained in this increment.
LIDAR temporal metadata — Dataset period is listed from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022. Limit: Composite age varies spatially and must be resolved by survey lineage.
OSGM02 to OSGM15 adjustment grid — Official adjustment-grid ZIP is listed; metadata revision date is 19 July 2024. Limit: ZIP bytes were not downloaded or hashed here.
Terrain 50 annual July update — OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July. Limit: Annual cadence does not prove current TQ tile bytes.

Terrain 50 bare-earth DTM role — DTM represents ground surface with buildings and trees removed and is intended for broad landscape analysis. Limit: 50m data remains secondary screening, not primary parcel measurement.
Terrain 50 tile and spacing — Grid supply uses 10 km by 10 km tiles with regular 50 m post spacing. Limit: Resolution is too coarse to replace 1m parcel sampling.
Terrain 50 ASCII grid structure — ASCII tiles have 200 rows by 200 columns, 50 m cell size and heights to 0.1 m. Limit: Structure alone does not verify the selected TQ tile.
Terrain 50 companion files — Supply includes ASC, GML, PRJ, auxiliary XML and per-tile metadata XML. Limit: All required current companion files remain unobserved.
Terrain 50 national supply — National grid supply contains 2,858 tiles in 55 folders and is available without registration. Limit: National supply facts do not establish tile-level freshness.
Terrain 50 per-tile metadata — Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI and records product identity and tile reference. Limit: Per-tile metadata has not been read for the target tile.
